_comment: health_tick step market-risk-escalation-stall (scripts/check_market_risk_escalation.py). A RED escalation is 'stalled' only when the evaluator that sends its repeats missed a run it was scheduled to make: the evaluator's run receipt (data/runtime/market_risk/run_last.json, written by every scheduled dry or apply run) is older than the latest scheduled slot that is at least overdue_after_min old. Outside the evaluator's schedule the step is silent (review of #2354: judging by send age paged 46 times over one weekend). The schedule mirrors the market-risk-evaluate crontab lines (lane registry note); trading_days_only follows scripts/market_day_gate.sh. At most max_pages_per_episode pages per episode, at most one per repeat_minutes. Operator approval 2026-10-31 (design §11 items 5 and 8). tick_interval_min is the health-tick cadence: one interval of slack after end+overdue keeps a window's last slot checkable. A run receipt that is unreadable, or dated more than future_skew_s ahead, counts as stale. The page cap is per episode opening (id + anchor_at), so a re-opened episode gets a fresh cap.
